mainEntity.name: Can AI help me build an MVP, or will I just end up with a fragile demo?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can help build a prototype quickly, but a prototype is evidence for learning, not proof that the business works. It may demonstrate a user flow while leaving security, reliability, accessibility, support, billing, and maintenance unresolved.

For digital products and online businesses, validate the customer problem and workflow before investing in a broad application. A simple landing page, manual service, or existing platform may test demand more cheaply than custom development.

Key factors:
- Whether real users complete the intended task.
- Accuracy and reliability of outputs.
- Cost of hosting and support.
- Ability to change or export the system later.

Practical guidance: Define prototype success in observable terms, test with representative users, record failures, and prioritize only validated improvements. Label experimental features and avoid collecting unnecessary sensitive data.

Run My AI Business helps owners connect product ideas with practical launch and workflow planning rather than promising automatic business success.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can help create an MVP, but speed does not prove reliability or demand. Define observable success, test with real users, track failures, and review security, support, hosting, and data needs before treating the prototype as a product.
